description_en: Deletes multiple meta entities in a batch. This operation deletes custom meta entities and extended table-based objects, such as databases and tables. You cannot delete a column individually. Instead, you must delete the entire table to remove its associated columns
description_zh: 批量删除元数据实体对象，支持删除创建的纯自定义实体，扩展表类型对象(Database/Table)，不支持单独删除column，可以通过删除Table,删除关联Column对象
name: BatchDeleteMetaEntities

parameters.help_en: An array of IDs for the meta entities to delete. You can specify up to 10 IDs in a single request. All entities in the batch must have the same EntityType
parameters.help_zh: 待删除实体ID列表，最多10个；同一批次必须为同一种entityType
parameters.name: ids

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

Results.description_en: An array of deletion results, one for each requested entity. Each result indicates whether the deletion was successful and includes an error message upon failure
Results.description_zh: 实体删除结果列表；逐条返回删除是否成功及失败原因

items.description_en: The deletion result for a single entity

Results.title_zh: 实体删除结果列表；逐条返回删除是否成功及失败原因

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. This parameter returns true even if the deletion of some entities fails. To check the status of each individual deletion, see the Success and ErrorMessage fields in the Results array
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功；部分实体失败时仍返回true，逐条结果见Results[].Success和Results[].ErrorMessage
Success.title_zh: 请求是否成功；部分实体失败时仍返回true，逐条结果见Results[].Success和Results[].ErrorMessage
